reason: The cited evidence confirms that SFE influences deformation mechanisms (E2, E3) and that Mn-containing CoCrFeNiMn has low SFE (~20-30 mJ/m²) associated with twinning (E1). However, no evidence directly compares SFE of the quinary alloy to the specific quaternary (Cr-Fe-Co-Ni) and ternary (Cr-Co-Ni) subsets, nor demonstrates that Mn addition is the cause of SFE differences among them. The premise that Mn lowers SFE relative to these subsets is therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
